_comment: Non-localised constants. Everything the user sees is in strings/.
_notif_comment: The notif=… field the diagnostics report must carry (roadmap item 5, step 33). 'allowed' on every lane: API 25..32 has no POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission, and run.py grants it on API 33+ before the flows so the one-time dialog never interrupts them.

profiles._comment: Which device the run expects. --profile picks one; run.py copies its fields onto the top level (installer_activity, uninstaller_activity, expected_device) and uses system_lang when --system-lang is left at 'auto'. The emulator profiles also name the AVD/image so a run can say what it booted. A profile may name the environment variable that holds the device's address (serial_env) so `--profile phone35` needs no --serial; the real address stays in the gitignored local.env. 'navigation' is how the app's own screens are driven: 'dpad' (TV) or 'touch' (phone) — both are still driven with `input` (D-pad + tap), a dedicated touch flow is roadmap item 3.

stick.description: Fire TV Stick 4K (AFTMM), Fire OS 6.7.1.1 = Android 7.1.2 = API 25. The primary target; the API 25 regression test runs here.

tv25.description: AOSP Android TV emulator, API 25 (system-images;android-25;android-tv;x86). The same platform as the stick but a plain Android TV, so the kind must be android_tv, not fire_tv.
tv25._installer_note: Like tv30, this image ships the Google installer package wrapping the AOSP activity classes. It has no touchscreen (-notouch), so touch=0.

tv30.description: AOSP Android TV emulator, API 30 (system-images;android-30;android-tv;x86). First platform where the API 26+ notification channel and the background-execution limits are real.
tv30._installer_note: This image ships the Google installer package (com.google.android.packageinstaller) wrapping the AOSP activity classes, and it reports a touchscreen (-finger), so touch=1.

phone34.description: Google APIs phone emulator, API 34 (system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64). The only image here that runs Android 12+, so it is what enforces the targetSdk 31 rules (PendingIntent mutability, notification trampolines).
phone34._installer_note: The Material installer on API 31+ says 'Install' / 'Cancel' (sentence case); the older AOSP installer says 'INSTALL' / 'CANCEL'. The uninstaller still says 'OK'. That is what system_strings points at.

phone35.description: A real arm64 phone running an Android 15 (API 35) LineageOS GSI with a touchscreen and a de-DE locale. Closes the arm64 asset gap — Plezy publishes arm64-v8a / armeabi-v7a / x86_64 only, so the 32-bit x86 TV images cannot install it — and adds API 35 on top of phone34's API 34. Runs the full flows over touch.
phone35._installer_note: The AOSP PackageInstaller on Android 15 uses sentence-case buttons in German: 'Installieren' for a first install, 'Aktualisieren' when replacing, 'Abbrechen', and the uninstaller still 'OK'. That 'Aktualisieren' is the one difference from the old AOSP installer, so this profile points at system.de.api34.json. The real address is NOT in this file — set PHONE_SERIAL in the gitignored local.env (see local.env.example).

language_rows._comment: The Settings -> Language picker's rows, in order (row 0 is the title). 'system' follows the device; the rest are language codes. The names are each language's own name, so the list reads the same whatever the app is currently set to — that is what lets the harness pick a row without knowing the current language.

versions._comment: The two releases the flows use. Bump these (or pass --latest/--older) when upstream moves on.
